law.catch_line: Issuance of currency and related prohibited acts

text.section:
No individual or entity, unless authorized by law, shall:
Issue any note, bill, scrip, or other paper or thing with intent that the same be circulated as currency; or
Otherwise deal, trade, or carry on business as a bank of circulation.
All contracts made for forming any entity to engage in any activity prohibited by subsection A shall be void.
